title: Better Music Commands
description: Lets you play individual tracks using commands.
body:
Also available for [Bedrock Edition](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/better-music-commands-bedrock-edition/)!

Allows you to play any individual piece from the soundtrack using commands.

Sound event naming scheme is "cb_music.track." followed by the track name in snake_case. All official names work. For example, to play Mice on Venus, the sound event would be either "cb_music.track.mice_on_venus" or "cb_music.track.piano3".

Plays the track at full volume, which the game does not always do during regular gameplay. If you want the track to play at its normal volume, you will have to supply it as part of the command.
